# Copilot Instructions

This is a demo Node.js web application with Express.js backend, React frontend, and PostgreSQL database.

## Repository context

- Language: TypeScript / JavaScript
- Framework: Express.js (backend), React (frontend)
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Deployment: Azure App Service
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions

## Coding standards

- Use TypeScript for all new code
- Follow ESLint rules defined in .eslintrc
- Write unit tests for all business logic
- Use conventional commits (feat:, fix:, docs:, etc.)
- API responses follow JSON:API spec

## Issue triage guidelines

When triaging issues:
- Security issues are always priority-high
- Production-impacting bugs are priority-high
- Feature requests with clear use cases are priority-medium
- Documentation improvements are priority-low
- Vague issues need clarification before triage
